csv_agency: Finger Lakes Development Disabilities Service Ofc
csv_scope_of_work: Designs for Bathroom Renovations. 1. Designs and specifications for 125 sq ft. (approx.) Bathroom Renovation 2. Product Specification Data. a. Construction details, material description, dimensions, profiles, finishes, and applicable schematics, and cut sheets. 3. All Designs and Specification documents need to be provided on Adobe (.pdf). 4. Document Submissions to be provided to OPWDD Point of Contact (POC) at routine Intervals: a. 90% Completion (Issued for Permitting- signed and stamped), b. 100% Completion 5. Internal Construction Permitting to be completed by the Maintenance Supervisor with necessary OPWDD Agency Personnel in Central Office. 6. Design Vendor shall provide two (2) sets of 24 x 36 blueprints upon completion, stamped/signed, and mailed to POC listed above. 7. Design Services shall also include: a. A Probable Construction Cost Estimate, based on current pricing, materials, and supplies.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: Cobblestone 107 IRA Bathroom Renovation
short_description: Design services for a small bathroom renovation in Newark, New York.
project_location: 107 Cobblestone Terrace, Newark, New York, USA
project_scope: Designs and specifications for an approximately 125 sq ft bathroom renovation, including construction details, material descriptions, dimensions, profiles, finishes, schematics, cut sheets, PDF deliverables, signed and stamped 90% permitting set, 100% completion set, two stamped 24 x 36 blueprint sets, and a probable construction cost estimate.
services: Bathroom renovation design services including interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, product specification data, and preparation of permitting documents.
relevance_explanation:
- Very small-scale interior renovation of approximately 125 sq ft.
- Primarily bathroom refurbishment with no notable structural, bridge, roof, or special engineering challenge.
- Does not match sbp's target focus on bridges, long-span structures, stadiums, special structures, or large/complex buildings.
- Includes some engineering disciplines, but the scope is essentially a minor building renovation.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The tender asks the design vendor to prepare a probable construction cost estimate. Available scope information indicates only a very small bathroom renovation of about 125 sq ft, which suggests a low construction value, but no reliable USD figure can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or budget is stated in the tender documents.
